 SC Freiburg vs. Bayern Munich - Head-to-head record
 The head-to-head record between SC Freiburg and Bayern Munich reveals a clear dominance by Bayern. In their last ten meetings, Bayern Munich secured eight wins . SC Freiburg has only one victory and one draw in these encounters.
 Bayern’s recent victories often featured high scores, including 5-0 and 6-2 results. These matches highlight their strong attacking power against Freiburg’s defence. Bayern frequently finds the back of the net with ease in this fixture.
 Freiburg’s sole win in the last ten games was a memorable 2-1 upset in the DFB Pokal quarter-finals. They also achieved a 2-2 league draw. While history largely favours Bayern, these instances demonstrate that an upset is still possible for SC Freiburg.

 SC Freiburg - Strong despite recent loss
 Let’s take a closer look at SC Freiburg’s current situation. Despite a recent defeat, the team has shown impressive form this season and sits comfortably near the top of the table. We will analyse their recent performances and tactical approach for this match against Bayern Munich.
 Recent form
 SC Freiburg has enjoyed a brilliant start to their Bundesliga campaign and is currently sitting in third place with 13 points. They secured four wins and a draw in their first six league matches, demonstrating their strong early-season form. However, they recently suffered their first loss after a narrow 2-1 defeat away to Bayer Leverkusen.
 Despite this setback away from home, Freiburg’s home performance in the Bundesliga has been perfect. They have won all three matches in front of their fans, scoring an impressive 11 goals while conceding only two. This formidable home record demonstrates their ability to dominate on their own turf — a key factor for this game.
 Freiburg have a full-strength squad. The only player who may miss the game is midfielder Engelhardt, who is being assessed for an injury. Key players such as midfielder Maximilian Eggestein and striker Matanović have been instrumental, each scoring three league goals. Midfielder Yuito Suzuki, who poses a significant threat, has also scored four goals in his last five appearances, providing another potent attacking option. Their collective form will be vital as they challenge the visitors in the SC Freiburg vs. Bayern Munich fixture.

 Bayern Munich - In formidable winning form
 Let’s take a look at Bayern Munich’s current situation. We will analyse their form, recent results, and the standout performers for the trip to Freiburg.
 Recent form
 Bayern Munich are top of the Bundesliga table with 14 points from six games. The German giants remain undefeated in the league, having secured four wins and two draws. Their attack is potent, having scored 22 goals while conceding just five.
 However, recent results suggest that they are not invincible, having drawn three of their last five matches across all competitions. These include a 2–2 draw with Arsenal in the UEFA Champions League and a 2–2 draw with FC Augsburg in the Bundesliga. In the Bundesliga, they have won one and drawn two of their last three away games.
 Bayern will need to cope with the absence of the injured Luis Díaz. Defender Kim Min-jae may also miss the game following an injury assessment. Nevertheless, star players such as Harry Kane, who has scored four goals and provided five assists, and Michael Olise, who has scored five goals, are in exceptional form. The creative influence of Kimmich will further strengthen their attack and present a significant challenge to the home defence.

 Predictions for SC Freiburg vs. Bayern Munich - Goals Expected
 Bayern Munich arrives with a high-powered attack, but Freiburg’s perfect home record suggests they won’t back down. This sets the stage for an open match, and with both teams in form, it could easily feature over 3.5 goals.
 Freiburg has scored in its last ten games, while Bayern’s recent draws show they can be vulnerable defensively. We anticipate a fast start from both sides, making it likely for there to be over 1.5 goals in the first half.
 Given the attacking talent on display and the historical trend of high-scoring games in this fixture, our main prediction is for a decisive result with plenty of action. We are backing the “ No Draw and Over 2.5 goals ” market.
